title: Independence of tautological classes and cohomological stability for strata of differentials
summary: The tautological rings of strata of differentials are known to be generated by divisor classes. In this paper, we give lower bounds on the degrees of relations among them, depending on the genus $g$ and the number of simple zeros. For strata with more than $4g/3$ simple zeros, our results show that there are no relations in degrees less than $\lfloor g/3 \rfloor + 1$.
